why: rc29: system chat lines, more alerts, presets, /wowfa target

args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.0.0-rc29 (test build, built by wowfa2 CI).

New: system lines in the chat are Persian (loot, money, experience, level up, reputation, skills, new spells, quest accepted / completed, new flight path, group joins and leaves). Item links are never touched. Switch: General > system lines (needs the Persian chat switch on).
New: about 40 more red alerts in the middle of the screen are Persian (not standing, mounted, stunned, silenced, bag full, quest log full, level too low and more).
New: two presets: story only (quests, NPC names and talk, zones) and spells only (spells, talents, terms).
New: /wowfa target writes the English name of your target, the key the data uses and the Persian name we have (or none). Use it to report a wrong NPC name.
Includes rc7 to rc28.

Data from ForeverDB.net
